title: Show Dropdown Chevron Affordance
description: UI dropdowns such as the example for playgrounds are currently not showing any chevron on the right, hence you currently cant see that it is dropdown compared to a button, etc. Fix so dropdowns show a visible chevron affordance on the right.
summary: SelectTrigger now keeps a visible trailing chevron: value text truncates with min-w-0/flex-1 so the icon is not clipped in fixed-width chrome (e.g. playground example dropdown), and the chevron no longer uses opacity-50. Combobox/ButtonGroupItem labels with justify-between also truncate so trailing icons stay visible.
